## Who is Aditya Jethani?

Aditya Jethani is a Machine Learning Engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. He builds production AI systems, specialising in agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM fine-tuning, and the ML infrastructure that takes models from prototype to production.

He is the first inventor on a published Indian patent for a multimodal healthcare AI system (Application No. 202521086225), a Codeforces Master placing in the top 2% of rated competitive programmers worldwide, and a Computer Engineering graduate of Pandit Deendayal Energy University with a CGPA of 9.44 out of 10.

He works end to end: data pipelines, model fine-tuning, FastAPI services, agent orchestration, and the evaluation tooling that proves a system behaves correctly. His approach is measurement-first: break an ambiguous problem into experiments, automate the evaluation, and iterate until the numbers hold.

## Professional experience

### Machine Learning Engineer, Logicwind (June 2025 to present), Surat, India

- Built 7 production AI agents that answer voice and text questions over live enterprise systems including ERPNext, Tally, CRM and regulatory data, planning their own tool and SQL calls from deep schema grounding rather than phrase matching. Validated to exact accuracy against ground truth, including reconciling 69.3 crore rupees in credits across 9,205 vouchers with zero error. Shipped across the OpenAI Agents SDK, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Mastra AI and Vercel AI SDK. Cut client delivery time by 70% and reached 90% response satisfaction.
- Built the company's governed internal AI platform to stop company data leaking into personal AI accounts. It provides per-user budgeted API keys, cost attribution, and per-user Model Context Protocol (MCP) OAuth isolation, and it caught a cross-user calendar data leak before it reached production. Extended into a single-tenant governed AI appliance where every agent action runs an identity, grants, policy-check and data-trust spine.
- Architected an agentic RAG platform over 360,000 multilingual documents, of which 45% were scanned images processed with Surya OCR, reaching 4.3x throughput through asynchronous batching and Qwen3 embeddings. Benchmarked 16+ chunking strategies and 6+ embedding models.
- Engineered an agentic natural-language-to-SQL interface that returns governed SQL plus auto-generated chart dashboards in under 2 seconds, giving non-technical stakeholders self-serve analytics.
- Built a deterministic PDF parser that beats PyMuPDF on 23 of 34 metrics across a custom 1,386-document financial benchmark. Manuscript in preparation.
- Built a generated-image evaluation framework pairing Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and CLIP-score with a custom relevance-scoring pipeline.
- Built an Edge-AI employee training platform with LLM-personalised learning paths and a proctored test environment using eye tracking, face detection and ambient-audio monitoring.
- Built a real-time KYC pipeline fusing face liveness detection, programmatic OCR and voice biometrics into a single low-latency on-device identity flow.

### Software Engineering Intern, Yanolja (January 2025 to June 2025), Surat, India

- Architected an image-to-image translation system for multilingual e-commerce that lifted accuracy 50% over the CycleGAN baseline, using ensemble OCR for text and attribute detection with LaMa in-painting, while preserving native language typography and visual aesthetics. Validated across 10+ evaluation metrics.
- Revamped an internal LLM-based code-analysis workflow, privately hosted on Google Cloud for GitHub pull requests, mining commit histories and pull-request diffs to mitigate 27% of recurring security vulnerabilities through automated RAG-based pattern detection.
- Engineered scalable computer-vision pipelines using Go, Python and FFmpeg, handling large image datasets and reducing average processing time by 1.3x.

### Machine Learning Intern, CybraneX (March 2024 to October 2024), Delhi, India

- Engineered a high-throughput RAG inference pipeline for QLoRA fine-tuned LLMs, achieving a 9x speedup from 110 seconds to 12.2 seconds by replacing serialized per-thread generation with GPU-batched inference. Sustained 139.6 tokens per second and 0.82 queries per second in production through FP16 quantization, KV-caching, FlashAttention-2 and context truncation.
- Built a clinical tongue-analysis computer-vision system reaching 94.2% colour accuracy and 91.7% coating accuracy. Engineered the full pipeline in OpenCV and scikit-image using segmentation, RGB and HSV ratio analysis, Local Binary Pattern texture mapping, Gabor filtering, Canny edge detection and 2D Fourier transforms to measure coating thickness and crack density. Shipped a REST API and interactive UI for real-time image upload, processing and report generation.
- Built an AI telemarketing system on custom LLMs handling 50,000+ calls a day at 89% accuracy in legitimate-lead identification, under sub-200 millisecond latency.
- Delivered an enterprise document-extraction product deployed on Azure, combining Cloud Vision OCR, tamper detection and LLM classification across 14+ document types with a CI/CD pipeline. Accelerated per-document processing from 5 seconds to 0.5 seconds.
- Built a real-time analytics dashboard blending purchase history and geolocation signals, raising a client's inventory turnover by 22%.

## Research, patents and publications

### Patent (published): AI-Powered Multimodal Healthcare System for Elderly Care

Indian Patent Application No. 202521086225. Filed 11 September 2025, published 3 July 2026. Aditya Jethani is the first inventor, with mentor Dr. Debabrata Swain. Applicant: Pandit Deendayal Energy University.

The invention is a multimodal healthcare assistant for elderly users. Its core novelty is a unified multimodal vector store that fuses text, image and audio data into a single embedding space through an attention-based feature-alignment layer with modality-specific weights, enabling cross-modal retrieval-augmented generation while minimising large-language-model input costs.

The system includes a Vision Transformer that classifies medical scans, prescriptions and diagnostic reports; speech-to-text, text-to-speech and optical character recognition for multimodal input; a context-aware mechanism that analyses conversation history; and an adaptive memory system that refines user data through iterative learning to deliver increasingly personalised medical guidance, medication reminders and lifestyle recommendations. It supports multiple languages including English and Hindi.

### Under review, IEEE Transactions: Advanced Forecasting of Solar Power Generation using Bi-LSTM with Fourier Features

First author. A bidirectional LSTM using 25 Fourier sine and cosine term pairs alongside geo-temporal features for multi-horizon AC power forecasting across two climatically distinct Indian photovoltaic plants. Achieves an R-squared of 0.861 and RMSE of 128.09 kW at the one-hour horizon. Includes an adversarial degradation model that simulates soiling, thermal faults and sensor bias to quantify yield loss and generate maintenance recommendations. Validated with 5-fold TimeSeriesSplit cross-validation and Optuna hyperparameter optimisation.

### In preparation: Deterministic Document Parsing that Outperforms VLM Parsers

A zero-machine-learning, failure-mode-driven PDF parser reaching a character error rate of 0.0135 and token-F1 of 0.99 on native PDFs. Beats PyMuPDF on 23 of 34 metrics across a custom 1,386-document financial benchmark under zero-regression gating, validated out of domain on TAT-DQA (2,758 documents), DocLayNet (25,699 documents) and RealDocBench (581 documents).

### Academic research: Efficient Labelling of Hinglish Datasets for Hate-Speech Classification

A dual-layered labelling method for low-resource code-mixed Hinglish. An ensemble-consensus pipeline using Twitter-RoBERTa, BETO/mBERT and VADER, combined with iterative refinement and human feedback, bootstraps a high-quality 18,000-sentence dataset, reaching 86% accuracy on hate-speech and sentiment classification.

## Projects

### Setu: Kumbh Lost and Found Network

Live at https://setu-kumbh.vercel.app/. An offline-first, voice-first platform that reunites families separated at the Kumbh Mela. Built with Next.js, Flutter and FastAPI. Uses Sarvam Saarika for speech-to-text and Bulbul for text-to-speech, supporting one-tap voice intake across 23 Indian languages for users who cannot read or type. The matching engine reached Recall@1 of 87% and Recall@5 of 97% on a reproducible evaluation, with hashed-PII privacy design. Built at Claude Impact Lab 2026, where it placed Top 7 in India.

### TalentScout AI

Live at https://aitalentscout.streamlit.app/. A production candidate-screening assistant that parses resumes, generates role-specific questions and scores answers with running confidence. Built with Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Llama 3.3 70B and Streamlit. Reached 85% validation accuracy and cut hiring evaluation time by 60%.

### Prompt Detective

Live at https://promptdetective.streamlit.app/. A multimodal pipeline that reverse-engineers the prompt behind an AI-generated image or video using computer-vision signal extraction and semantic retrieval. Built with OpenCV, CLIP, Sentence-Transformers and pgvector. Reached 85% Top-K accuracy with under 5 seconds processing for a one-minute video.

### Grade Flow

Live at https://gradeflow.streamlit.app/. A RAG teacher's assistant that automates grading with plagiarism detection, automatic question-paper generation and a timed test environment. Built with FastAPI, LangGraph, pgvector, FAISS and Gemma-2. Automated 90% of the grading workflow and cut evaluation time by 75%.

### Tongue Analysis AI

A clinical computer-vision system for traditional-medicine diagnostics, analysing coating, colour and cracks across 2,524 images to replace subjective scoring. Built with PyTorch, OpenCV, scikit-image and Flask. Reached 94.2% colour accuracy and 91.7% coating accuracy.

### Company Brain

https://github.com/okaditya84/Company-Brain. A multi-tenant RAG platform with hybrid semantic search and citation-grounded answers to reduce hallucination, served through asynchronous microservices. Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis and Docker, gated by a CI pipeline running lint, type-checks, migrations and tests.

### Neural ODE for Heart Rate

https://github.com/okaditya84/Neural-ODE-for-Heart-Rate. A continuous-time ordinary-differential-equation model reconstructing and forecasting irregularly sampled ICU heart-rate trajectories from MIMIC-III with masked-point imputation. Built with PyTorch and torchdiffeq. Reached MSE of 0.443 and RMSE of approximately 7.01 beats per minute.

### Scrollwise

A full-stack digital-wellbeing app and Chrome extension that turns scroll, click and focus events into real-world analogies with AI insights. Built with Next.js, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB and Groq, with under 500 millisecond insight latency.

### BOB Agent

https://github.com/okaditya84/BOB-Agent. A safety-first banking assistant with output guardrails and a Model Context Protocol server across four microservices (identity, KYC, assistant and gateway), orchestrated with Docker Compose and verified by an 88-case pytest suite.
